label_rule: Two distinct papers are related when both have positive relevance judgments for the same claim. These are proxy labels, not direct recommendation ratings.
development: Training-claim pairs after removing every paper appearing in any multi-positive test claim; remove empty anchors
test: All anchors in multi-positive test claims; recommend from all 5183 papers, excluding the seed
split_guard: No development anchor or positive target may be a test anchor
baseline: Unmodified stored MiniLM title-plus-abstract cosine neighbors
tie_break: Prefer baseline, then earlier grid entry
uncertainty: 10000 paired bootstrap resamples of positive-graph connected components; seed 42
external_test: All 1000 official SciDocs recommendation test click events, restricted to their 10 displayed candidates. Frozen SciFact-selected method; no external test tuning.
external_metrics: Click rank, nDCG@10, hit@1, hit@5, MRR; inverse display-position propensity weighted variants; bootstrap grouped by seed paper
scope: Local full-corpus proxy retrieval and external logged-candidate reranking are separate tasks; neither is a calibrated probability of relevance or a personalized user study.
